baseline: latest earlier complete v already visible at prediction time
correlation_warning: minute rows are serially correlated and are not independent statistical trials
data_source: existing immutable minute KWI recorder manifests and hash-addressed raw payloads
eligibility_rule: At first observation of an incomplete city x t point, numeric station count must equal contributors from the latest earlier complete point already visible for the same city and config_version.
market_edge_rule: No market edge is inferred from this signal test.
predictor: arithmetic mean of all numeric temp_f values in that first eligible incomplete snapshot
rejection_rule: If survival rule fails, reject this full-station pre-canonical signal formulation without tuning on the same prospective window.
survival_rule: At least two cities must each have at least 30 eligible prospective pairs, and predictor MAE must beat persistence MAE overall and in every city meeting the minimum sample threshold.
target: later complete v for identical city and t
